sampling_model.design: For each \(n\), observe an independent sample \(O_{n1},\ldots,O_{nn}\) from the row law \(P_n\in\mathcal M\); rows may vary arbitrarily with \(n\).
sampling_model.units: The number of multinomial atoms \(|\mathcal J|\) is fixed, while their probabilities may vanish with \(n\).
sampling_model.treatment: The instrument and treatment are binary; the outcome has the fixed ordered support \(\mathcal Y\), and selection is observed.
sampling_model.overlap: The inferential class strengthens the inherited pointwise model only by fixed uniform bounds \(\epsilon\le P_n(Z=1\mid X=x)\le1-\epsilon\) and \(M(p_n)\ge m_*\); individual cells and cut gaps may vanish.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The empirical atom vector \(\widehat p_n\) is the sole first-stage estimator. Algebraic division is totalized by \(u\oslash0=0\), the endpoint center uses \(\Phi_{\mathrm{ext}}(\widehat p_n)=(0,1)\) at zero aggregate empirical mass, and \(C_n=\mathbb R^2\) when that fallback is invoked or the legal base set is empty. The common Gaussian draw is realized through the principal covariance square root, and its measurable critical value uses the lower-quantile convention. No support screening, variance floor, or deterministic calibration guard is used.

body.tldr: The accepted parent continues to identify the causal set sharply as \(\Theta_I(p)=[L(p),U(p)]\), and the proposed common-Gaussian rectangle is a well-defined measurable statistic. This note does not establish its uniform joint coverage over arbitrary triangular arrays. What is proved is exact oracle \(1-\alpha\) calibration at every fixed separated regular face, uniformly negligible fallback probability and \(O_{P_n}(n^{-1/2})\) finite-coordinate width, an explicit \(K=4\) changing-support diagnostic with exact limiting coverage, a \(K=4\) singleton-cell counterexample to every even symmetric max-linear probe satisfying both pointwise legal-envelope domination and nearby endpoint-increment domination, and a ray-restricted finite-slope oriented repair on that face. The legal-relative-comparison question is now the sole all-array inferential target. Global simultaneous-face pointwise domination, complete latent transfer with covariance traction, relative non-even lower-quantile transfer, and the exact-zero-scale branch remain unproved.

project_justification.gap: The accepted parent settles sharp identification for the finite ordered survivor-complier benefit interval. Existing inference results do not supply the legal observed-law inner-neighborhood comparison and relative critical-value transfer required when support, active-cut gaps, and endpoint scales may collapse. The explicit legal \(K=4\) singleton-cell construction proves that every even symmetric max-linear probe satisfying both pointwise legal-envelope domination and nearby endpoint-increment domination fails, while the ray-restricted finite-slope oriented construction repairs parity and finite curvature only on that face. Global simultaneous-face pointwise domination, complete latent transfer with covariance traction, relative non-even lower-quantile transfer, and the exact-zero-scale branch remain unresolved.
project_justification.niche: The fixed finite multinomial model permits a total semialgebraic endpoint extension, a measurable nearby-legal-base directional envelope, and common-Gaussian calibration. These ingredients give exact oracle behavior on separated faces and root-\(n\) width control without individual cell, cut-gap, or variance floors. The singleton-cell analysis shows that legality is intrinsically oriented at a binding selection-total face, but it does not resolve intersections of capacity, selection-total, and active-cut faces.
project_justification.fill: The proved contribution combines the imported sharp endpoint map with a measurable total procedure, exact separated-face oracle calibration, uniform fallback and width control, an explicit \(K=4\) stress-test array, a counterexample ruling out every even symmetric-probe reduction satisfying both required domination properties, and a ray-restricted finite-slope oriented parity and finite-curvature repair on the counterexample face. The legal-relative-comparison question is the sole remaining all-array inferential target; no theorem-level uniform joint coverage claim is made. No support, cut-gap, cell-mass, or variance floor, screening rule, or deterministic guard is introduced.

body.related_work: The accepted CausalSmith survivor-complier benefit result supplies the exact sharp endpoint formula and full-law sharpness; identification is imported rather than reproved. Angrist, Imbens, and Rubin (1996) support conditional instrument randomization, treatment consistency, and no defiers, while Dong and Heiler (2026) support treatment-mediated selection and outcome consistency together with covariate-specific weak selection monotonicity. The fixed \(\epsilon\) overlap bound and fixed \(m_*\) aggregate denominator floor are uniform-class strengthenings here. Fang and Santos (2019) and Hong and Li (2018) motivate derivative-aware resampling, but their generic results do not construct the required nearby legal observed laws. Frandsen and Pond (2025), Imai and Okamoto (2026), and Andrews and Guggenberger (2009) begin from regular, asymptotically linear, or standardized representations that do not resolve the present one-sided legal-face problem at vanishing scale. The standalone proposition \(\text{prop:oriented-probe-frontier}\) records the exact method frontier on one explicit \(K=4\) singleton-covariate face: every even finite max-absolute-linear probe satisfying legal-envelope domination fails to dominate all nearby endpoint increments, whereas the oriented ray repairs parity and supplies nearby-legal derivative domination of the opposite finite increment on that face. All-array legal comparison and critical-value transfer remain unresolved. Consequently, the proved measurability, width, separated-face calibration, diagnostic, negative symmetric certificate, and singleton-face oriented certificate do not establish all-array uniform joint coverage.
body.interpretation: The causal target remains the same-unit benefit probability \(\theta_B\), and the imported identification theorem gives its sharp identified set \(\Theta_I(p)=[L(p),U(p)]\). The empirical center, directional envelope, Gaussian critical value, and rectangle are observed-law procedures; they do not define the causal target. At separated regular faces the rectangle has exact oracle Gaussian calibration. Uniformly over the maintained class, its fallback event is negligible and its finite coordinate widths are root-\(n\) on the complementary event. The explicit \(K=4\) diagnostic also has exact limiting coverage, the singleton-cell certificate rules out every even symmetric-probe proof having both required domination properties, and the ray-restricted finite-slope oriented construction repairs that single face. These facts do not imply uniform coverage over all changing-support and simultaneous tied-face arrays; that implication is precisely the unresolved legal-relative-comparison question.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The explicit legal \(K=4\) singleton-cell construction proves that no even functional \(\max_\nu|a_\nu^{\mathsf T}z|\) lying below the legal envelope can dominate all nearby endpoint increments. A ray-restricted finite-slope oriented construction and an explicit survivor-to-never-selected transfer repair parity and finite curvature on that face. Globally, intersections of raw-capacity zeros, selection-total ties, and tied lower or upper cuts permit cancellations among numerator, denominator, and cut derivatives, so pointwise domination of every required oriented row by the full legal envelope is unproved. The legal donor transfers change both outcome margins, and a complete latent response-type transfer with row-by-row covariance traction is also unavailable. Consequently relative lower-quantile transfer for the non-even Gaussian maximum and the exact-zero-scale local-flatness branch remain unproved. The legal-relative-comparison question is therefore the sole all-array inferential target, and all-array uniform joint coverage is not established.
body.honest_scope: Sharp identification is imported from the accepted parent. This note proves measurability of the total procedure, exact oracle \(1-\alpha\) coverage at fixed separated regular faces, uniformly negligible fallback probability and \(O_{P_n}(n^{-1/2})\) finite-coordinate width, the stated \(K=4\) changing-support diagnostic, a legal singleton-cell counterexample to every even symmetric-probe reduction satisfying both required domination properties, and a ray-restricted finite-slope oriented repair on that singleton face. It does not prove global simultaneous-face pointwise domination, complete latent transfer with covariance traction, relative non-even lower-quantile validity, the exact-zero-scale branch, or uniform joint coverage over arbitrary triangular arrays. The legal-relative-comparison question is the sole all-array inferential target. No individual support, survivor-cell, cut-gap, or variance floor and no screening or deterministic guard is imposed.
